title: Event spec (version 1)
description: One event (a run): the guided form in Discord, `/run create` with a file and the dashboard all write this, and `runs.spec` stores it. The bot does the final check (bot/events.py `resolve`: fights, dates, cutoffs before the first slot, open_at before the first cutoff); this schema covers the shape. Times are wall-clock in the bot's grid timezone, except cutoff_at and announce.open_at, which are in cutoff_timezone (default: the grid timezone).

content.description: A fight the bot knows (Ultima Weapon (Ultimate), ...). Required unless mode is "availability".

mode.description: "roles": seven-role party matchmaking. "availability": only collect who can make which slot (when2meet style): no roles, prog, limits, solver or parties.

party_size.description: Group size an availability event looks for (default 8). Only with mode "availability".

first_start.description: Default first slot start of every day. Default: config day_start.

last_start.description: Default latest slot start of every day. Default: config last_start.

slot_minutes.description: Default slot length. Default: config slot_minutes.

days_before.description: 0 = the day itself, 1 = the evening before. Default: config cutoff_days_before.

cutoff.description: Default signup cutoff of every day that has no cutoff_at.

days.description: At least one day. A range, or a list of dates / day objects. At most config max_run_days (14).

cutoff_at.description: Exact signup cutoff of this day.

channel_id.description: Channel the bot posts the announcement in when the event opens.

open_at.description: The bot opens the event by itself at this time. Must be in the future and before the first cutoff.
